title: Professional Certificate in Developing a Research Conceptual Framework
description: The Professional Certificate in Developing a Research Conceptual Framework aims to enable the learner to understand and develop a professional research conceptual framework.
longDescription: The Conceptual Model. Sources of Conceptual Framework. Types of Conceptual Framework. Types of Connection. Things to Watch Out for the Conceptual Framework. Importance of Conceptual Framework In Research. Steps for Building a Good Conceptual Framework. Conceptual Framework Example. Where does the Conceptual Framework Appear In Research? Difference between Conceptual Framework and Theoretical Framework. The Professional Certificate in Developing a Research Conceptual Framework aims to enable the learner to understand and develop a professional research conceptual framework by explaining key concepts in developing a conceptual framework with practical examples.
